name: io.github.tonyyang0504/coupang-mcp
description: Coupang (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing. Every tool maps to a d

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_COUPANG_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Coupang Open API Access Key issued in WING (판매자정보 > 추가판매정보 > OPEN API 키 발급) after business verification; calls must come from one of the (up to 10) allow-listed IPs, and keys expire and must be re-issued.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_COUPANG_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The matching Secret Key: signs every request (HMAC-SHA256 hex over signed-date + method + path + query, sent as `Authorization: CEA algorithm=HmacSHA256, access-key=..., signed-date=..., signature=...`). Never sent on the wire.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_COUPANG_VENDOR_ID
environmentVariables.description: Coupang vendorId (업체코드, e.g. A00012345), shown in WING after login; used by the probe.
